data.name: Creturner
data.description: Creturner Group AB is a publicly listed Swedish environmental technology group with two business areas: a digital/high-performance-computing division and an environmental division that offers corporate customers a permanent offsetting method based on Biochar Carbon Removal (BCR), converting residual biomass into carbon for storage. The company is listed on NGM Nordic SME in Stockholm and on the Stuttgart Stock Exchange in Germany. The firm is headquartered in Smedjebacken, Sweden and remains operationally active as of early 2026.
